en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing several men handling a large fishing net on a wooden platform beside a fast‑flowing river surrounded by dense coniferous forest. Rocks line the riverbank and simple wooden structures extend over the water. The scene has a rural, early‑20th‑century feel. The upper left corner of the image bears the printed word "Kotka." and the lower center margin reads "Langinkoski".
